llm.summary: This skill is a transparent SaaS skill-recommendation guide with limited, purpose-aligned reads, ClawHub search calls, and a scoped report write.

dimensions.detail: It asks to read SOUL.md and make network calls to clawhub.ai, which is proportionate for personalized skill discovery but may expose product context through search-query choices.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact is a single Markdown skill with no bundled executable scripts, package installs, or remote code execution behavior.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Instructions are bounded to reading the agent mission file, querying ClawHub search endpoints, applying stated filters, and writing a recommendations report; there are no hidden role changes, prompt overrides, or unsafe automatic installs.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: It writes a dated report under memory/reports, which is disclosed and scoped to the skill's weekly discovery/reporting purpose; it does not request elevated privileges or persistent hooks.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is to recommend up to three ClawHub skills for SaaS agents, and the instructions align with that purpose by reading product context, searching ClawHub, scoring candidates, and producing a recommendation report.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Before installing, be aware that the skill may read your agent mission and stack details and write a persistent recommendation report. Its guidance is advisory: review recommended skills and run the suggested security audit before installing anything for agents with billing, auth, or customer-data access.
